title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — schema variant registry
description: Registry of all photo-entry schema variants, keyed by SiteShrimp workCategory. Adding a new domain variant: (1) drop a schema file at /schema/entries/<id>/v1.json, (2) append an entry below mapping the workCategory to its URI and any extra Entries-sheet columns, (3) add both files to the service-worker pre-cache list. No app code change required. Modeled after the language-pack pattern (lang/<code>.json) so domain coverage scales by configuration, not by code.
x-i18n-convention: Variant extra_columns entries MAY carry an 'x-i18n' object with locale-keyed alternates for display fields, e.g. { "header": { "zh": "评估范围", "fr": "Zone d'évaluation" } }. Consumers resolve at render time against lang/<code>.json. The English 'header' value remains the canonical column key on the wire — translations are display-only and never affect the property name or stored value. Same principle as the base schema's x-i18n-convention: storage stable in English, display localised.

variants.title: CONQUAS — Internal Finishes
variants.description: Adds assessment_zone (Architectural / Structural / M&E) and inspection_lot. Tightens conquas_element to required and restricts it to the seven IF elements (no 'Other').
variants.ai_prompt_hint: CONQUAS-aware mode: emit assessment_zone ("Architectural" / "Structural" / "M&E") for every photo. Use BCA Good Industry Practice defect-type vocabulary verbatim.

variants.title: Building Defects — Landed
variants.description: Adds storey_count, party_wall_side, roof_type for landed-house typology context.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Landed-house mode: when storey count is visible from the photo, emit storey_count. When the photo shows a wall that may be a party wall (terrace / cluster / semi-detached), note party_wall_side. When roof typology is visible, emit roof_type.

variants.title: Building Defects — Highrise
variants.description: Adds block_or_tower, unit_no, vertical_zone for tower/condo context.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Highrise mode: when a block/tower sign or unit number is visible, emit block_or_tower / unit_no. Identify vertical_zone (Lobby / Lift Core / Corridor / Unit Interior / Common Area / Carpark / Refuse / Plant Room / Roof) from visible context.

variants.title: Construction Site (WSH frame)
variants.description: WSH-frame variant: severity is interpreted as injury risk (Critical = fatal/serious-injury, Major = lost-time, Minor = first-aid, Observation = near-miss). Adds hazard_category (required), ppe_compliance, stop_work_recommended, workers_exposed.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Construction Site / WSH mode: this is workplace-safety analysis, NOT contractual-defect grading. Re-interpret severity as injury risk: Critical = fatal/serious-injury risk, Major = lost-time injury, Minor = first-aid, Observation = near-miss. Always emit hazard_category from {Working at Heights / Scaffolding / Electrical / Confined Space / Hot Work / Chemicals / Falling Objects / Mobile Plant / Manual Handling / Site Condition / Other}. Emit ppe_compliance only if workers are visible. Emit stop_work_recommended=true only when severity is Critical AND active work is visible. Emit workers_exposed as a count when applicable.

variants.title: Interior Works
variants.description: Adds trade_subscope and permit_no for fit-out / renovation / interior-design context.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Interior Works mode: emit trade_subscope from {Carpentry / Painting / Tiling / M&E – Electrical / M&E – Plumbing / M&E – ACMV / Wallpaper / Glass / Mirror / Stone / Wood Flooring / Other} based on the affected trade. Permit numbers are user-supplied — leave permit_no null unless visible in the photo.

variants.title: Facilities Management
variants.description: Adds service_category (required), maintenance_type, asset_id for in-operation FM context.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Facilities Management mode: this is in-operation maintenance, NOT defect-liability inspection. Always emit service_category from {HVAC / Plumbing / Electrical / Fire Safety / Lift / Cleaning / Pest Control / Landscape / Security / General}. Emit maintenance_type from {Preventive / Reactive / Corrective / Breakdown / Inspection} based on the work nature. Asset IDs are owner-private — leave asset_id null unless an asset tag is visible.

variants.title: Infrastructure Works
variants.description: Adds asset_class (required), chainage_km, structure_id for civil / linear-asset context.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Infrastructure Works mode: this is civil / linear-asset inspection, NOT building defect. Always emit asset_class from {Road / Drainage / Linkway / External Works / Bridge / Tunnel / Culvert / Manhole / Other}. Emit chainage_km only for linear assets when a km marker is visible. Emit structure_id only when a structure-ID plate is visible. Severity remains Critical/Major/Minor/Observation interpreted as structural/serviceability impact.

variants.title: Handover Walkthrough
variants.description: Pre-handover snag list with unit / room context and a sign-off owner so each defect routes to the right party for rectification before keys handover.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Handover Walkthrough mode: pre-keys snag list. When a unit number is visible (door plate, signage), emit unit_no. Identify room from {Living Room / Dining Room / Kitchen / Master Bedroom / Bedroom 2 / Master Bathroom / Common Bathroom / Toilet / Yard / Balcony / Store / Utility / Foyer / Hallway / Common Area / External} based on visible context. Severity is interpreted as buyer-impact: Critical = unit not handover-ready, Major = significant defect to fix before move-in, Minor = cosmetic, Observation = note-only. Emit signoff_owner from {Developer / Main Contractor / Sub-contractor / Interior Fit-out / M&E Contractor / Vendor / Owner / Other} based on which trade the defect falls under.

variants.title: Test & Commission (T&C)
variants.description: Functional / pass-fail test outcomes with measured value, witnessing party, and re-test status. Drives contractual T&C records.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: Test & Commission mode: this is functional-test reporting, NOT contractual-defect grading. Always emit test_type from {Water Tightness Test (WTT) / Water Pressure Test (WPT) / Water Flow Test (WFT) / Electrical Insulation Resistance / Earth Continuity / Polarity Test / ACMV Air Balancing / ACMV Water Balancing / Lift Functional Test / Fire Alarm Functional Test / Sprinkler Hydrostatic Test / Smoke Detector Test / Lighting Lux Level / Drainage Smoke Test / Other} based on visible context (test rig / instrument / setup). Severity reflects test outcome: Critical = fail with safety implication, Major = fail requiring re-test, Minor = marginal pass, Observation = monitoring note. Emit measured_value with units only if a clear reading is visible (e.g. pressure gauge, multimeter, lux meter).

variants.title: M&E Inspection
variants.description: Services-focused inspection — adds m&e service line, equipment / asset reference, and rating from nameplate. Routes defects to the right specialist trade.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: M&E Inspection mode: services-focused trade inspection. Always emit me_service from {Plumbing / Sanitary / Electrical — LV / Electrical — ELV / Electrical — Lighting / ACMV — Air-side / ACMV — Water-side / Fire Protection / Fire Detection / Lift / Escalator / Gas / Standby Generator / BMS / Controls / Other} based on visible service / fitting / fixture. Equipment IDs only when a tag / nameplate is visible — copy verbatim, don't infer. Rating from nameplate (e.g. '50 A 415V', '5 hp', '300 m³/h') — copy verbatim. Severity reflects safety + serviceability impact specific to that service.

variants.title: TOP Inspection (BCA Temporary Occupation Permit readiness)
variants.description: BCA TOP readiness variant. Each defect carries a verbatim BCA NC category, Approved Document / COA / TRSS clause reference, threshold-breached note, and a readiness_gate flag (whether the NC is a TOP blocker). Severity is reinterpreted as TOP impact: Critical = blocks TOP, Major = NC requiring rectification, Minor = advisory, Observation = informational. Sources: BCA BPTOP industry sharing 2026 items 1-5; CSCTOP Form Companion v1.0 29 Apr 2026; Approved Document Ver 7.08 effective 1 Oct 2025.
variants.ai_prompt_hint: TOP Inspection mode: BCA Temporary Occupation Permit readiness check, not contractual-defect grading. Reinterpret severity as TOP impact — Critical = blocks TOP (rectify before inspection), Major = NC requiring rectification, Minor = advisory, Observation = informational. Always emit top_nc_category VERBATIM from {Lightning Protection System / Headroom & Ceiling Height / Safety from Falling — barriers / Safety from Falling — gaps / Staircase / Accessible Washrooms / Doorways / Ramps / Accessible Route Provision / Accessible Route Width / Mode of Ventilation / Env. Sustainability — NRB02 (door / vestibule) / Env. Sustainability — NRB06 (chiller / pump / cooling tower / AHU) / Storey Shelter (S/C SS) / Fixed Installations (Lifts / Escalators / MCPS) / Glass safety barrier / Site Readiness / Other}. Emit top_clause_ref using verbatim BCA clause notation: AD §C cl. C.3.2.1 (headroom ≥2.0 m); AD §E cl. E.3.4.4 + COA 4.11.2 (staircase uniform within 5 mm, non-slip nosing 50–65 mm permanent contrasting, tape NOT acceptable); AD §H cl. H.3.2.1 / H.3.4A.1 (barrier ≥1 m, ≥850 mm from last toehold); AD §H cl. H.3.4.1, H.3.4.3a (gap ≥75 mm at lowest part, opening must not pass 100 mm sphere non-industrial); AD §L cl. 3.1 (LPS per SS 555); COA cl. 2.1.1, 4.2.1, 4.5.2, 5.2.1 (accessibility); TRSS 2.12.1(e), 2.12.2 (storey shelter — no openings except 2 vent sleeves + MV; fire door opens away from staircase at fire discharge level); ES Code 4th ed. NRB02-2 (self-closing doors / vestibules / ANSI-AMCA 220 air-curtain ≥2.0 m/s); NRB06-1 (chiller ≥1.5 m), NRB06-4 (AHU >35 kW floor mount per SS 553); BC (FI) Regs 2025 (sheltered passage 1.0 × 2.0 m, lift refuge spaces). Emit top_threshold_breached when a measurement is visible (e.g. 'headroom 1850 mm < 2000 mm', 'barrier gap 95 mm > 75 mm'). Set top_readiness_gate=true when the NC is a TOP blocker; false for advisory NCs.
